title: Existing proper Serre-heart input: qbar
statement: Fix a prime ℓ and a field k with ringChar(k) ≠ ℓ. Let Y be a Noetherian k-scheme with structure map aY and p:Z→Y a proper morphism. For a commutative condensed ring Λ, write A_T for ordinary module objects over its pullback to T and R p_*:D(A_Z)→D(A_Y) for total right derived pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let S_Z be the smallest class of A_Z containing constructible modules and closed under isomorphisms, kernels, cokernels, extensions and coproducts indexed in Type (u+1). Then ProperLowerStarHeartHypotheses(Λ,p) means: there exists d∈ℤ such that R p_*(M[0]) is at most d for every M∈S_Z, and for every such small family (M_j) in S_Z the canonical map ⊕ R p_*(M_j[0])→R p_*(⊕ M_j[0]) is invertible. Let Λ be the condensed algebraic closure of ℚ_ℓ, whose sections take values in a finite coefficient extension. Then ProperLowerStarHeartHypotheses(Λ,p) holds.

source.place: Heart amplitude and direct sums; source-library ProperLowerStarEllAdic coefficient case

proof.text: The continuous, integral or algebraicClosure coefficient constructor supplies IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient for exactly this coefficient object and multiplication. Apply properLowerStar_uniformBound_ellAdic with the given Noetherian target, proper morphism and structure map to obtain the first conjunct of ProperLowerStarHeartHypotheses directly on constructibleCoproductClosure.

For any J-indexed family N in the module heart, every singleFunctor 0 (N j) is in degrees at least zero. Properness implies that p is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Apply condensed_boundedBelow_preservesCoproduct with common lower bound zero. Preservation of this discrete colimit makes its canonical sigmaComparison invertible, giving the second conjunct. This holds for all heart modules and therefore for the required subclass without using its membership hypothesis. It includes the empty family and uses no IndCons closure or constant-model comparison.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 5.3(1), via the existing proved common-lower-bound coproduct theorem; amplitude from the existing Noetherian proper heart bound (Bhatt--Scholze 6.7.2 and 6.8.15).
